description: Stations de référence de données FLEPOS Rinex is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agentschap Digitaal Vlaanderen. Real-time GNSS data from the GNSS receivers of FLEPOS reference stations are stored daily in a standard RINEX (Receiver Independent Exchange Format) exchange format and made available for download. The data is stored as both 1sec and 10 sec. Coverage: Agentschap Digitaal Vlaanderen. The portal shows the English title as "FLEPOS Rinex data reference stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agentschap Digitaal Vlaanderen. Its keywords include GNSS FLEPOS RINEX, hergebruik postprocessing, postprocessing data FLEPOS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
